info.title: Streamer Toolkit Host
info.description: Local Host API on 127.0.0.1. `/ws/overlay` is a read-only WebSocket: the first message is a `Snapshot`, then events such as `ChatMessageEvent`, `AlertEvent`, `ObsStatusEvent`, `TemplateChangedEvent`, `RedemptionChangedEvent`, `CheckinChangedEvent`, `CheckinStampedEvent` and `SoundPlayEvent` follow in `seq` order.

post.summary: Imports the file in one transaction; the same file imported again gives the same totals.

requestBody.description: The import file: an object keyed by Twitch user ID (at most 5 MB)

400.description: `checkin.import_invalid`: not JSON, or not an object

post.summary: What importing this file would change; nothing is written. The admin UI posts the chosen file's content.

requestBody.description: The import file: an object keyed by Twitch user ID (at most 5 MB)

400.description: `checkin.import_invalid`: not JSON, or not an object

post.summary: Puts a dead letter back in line with a fresh set of attempts.
Gives up on a dead letter: that redemption never checks in.

get.summary:
Helix Get Custom Reward (scope `channel:read:redemptions`). A channel without channel points is refused by
Twitch: 502 `twitch.request_refused`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Part of the login or display name; ASCII letters ignore case.

200.description: Recorded, or already checked in that day

400.description: `checkin.invalid_date`: not a date, or a future business day

get.summary: Tile IDs in display order; `null` when never arranged (the admin UI shows its defaults).

put.summary:
Saves the tile order: up to 50 IDs of 1-32 characters `[a-z0-9-]`; duplicates keep their first position.
`null` restores the defaults; `[]` keeps the home empty.
Saves the address (and the password, when given) and reconnects with them.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: RFC 3339; records redeemed at or after it.

parameters.name: viewer
parameters.description: Part of the viewer's login or display name; ASCII letters ignore case.

parameters.name: reward
parameters.description: Part of the reward name; ASCII letters ignore case.

400.description: `redemption.invalid_filter`: a bad time, status or page size

post.summary: Sends a follow, sub, resub, gift, cheer or raid tagged `source=simulation` through the same path as Twitch.
Sends a chat message tagged `source=simulation` through the same path as Twitch chat.
Shows a stamp card on `/overlay/checkin/` tagged `source=simulation`; nothing is recorded.
Copies an MP3, WAV or OGG file (at most 10 MB) into the library at 100% volume. The body is the file itself.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The original file name: its extension must match the content; the rest becomes the label.

400.description: `sound.unsupported_type`: not an MP3, WAV or OGG file (by extension and content)

put.summary: Renames a sound or changes its volume.

400.description: `sound.invalid`: an empty label or a volume over 100

delete.summary: Deletes a sound and its file.

post.summary: Plays a sound once on `/overlay/sound/` (`source=simulation`), to test it in OBS; nothing is recorded.

put.summary: Switches the alert overlay template and saves the choice; overlays reload it at once (`template.changed`).
Switches the chat overlay template and saves the choice; overlays reload it at once (`template.changed`).

AlertEvent.description:
An `alert` event exactly as `/ws/overlay` sends it: the event envelope around its payload. Not kept in
snapshots, so a reloaded overlay never replays one.

AlertPayload.description: The `payload` of an `alert` event. Fields the kind does not have are left out.

durationMs.description: How long the overlay shows it; the next alert comes after this and a short pause.

message.description: Raw viewer text of a `resubscribe` or `cheer`, when there is one.

sound.description: Played once as the alert starts; chosen per kind in the sound settings.

userName.description: Raw viewer text; `null` for an anonymous gift or cheer. Overlays escape it when rendering.

AlertSound.description: The sound an alert plays: the overlay's built-in one, none, or a library sound.

AlertTemplate.description: Which built-in template the alert overlay shows.

AuthStatus.description: What the admin UI may see; never contains tokens.

ChatMessageEvent.description: A `chat.message` event exactly as `/ws/overlay` sends it: the event envelope around its payload.

color.description: `#RRGGBB`, or `null` when the user never picked a color.

text.description: Raw viewer text; overlays escape it when rendering.

ChatTemplate.description: Which template the chat overlay shows. `custom` (the data folder's `templates/chat/`) has no UI entry.

CheckinChangedEvent.description:
A `checkin.changed` event exactly as `/ws/overlay` sends it: a viewer checked in. It carries only the viewer's
ID, so viewer text stays off this event; the admin UI reloads its lists. Not kept in snapshots.

CheckinDeadLetter.description:
A redemption the check-in module failed to take five times in a row. `user_name` and `reward_title` are raw
Twitch text.

CheckinOutbox.description: Redemptions waiting for the check-in module (while it is paused), and those it failed to take.

oldest_pending_at.description: RFC 3339: when the oldest waiting redemption happened.

CheckinSettingsBody.description: The check-in settings. `command` is stored without its `!`; a leading one is accepted and dropped.

reset_hour.description: Local hour a new business day starts, 0–23.

reward_id.description: Twitch ID of the channel points reward that checks in; `null`: chat only.

CheckinStampedEvent.description:
A `checkin.stamped` event exactly as `/ws/overlay` sends it: a stamp card to show on `/overlay/checkin/`. The
Host sends them one at a time. Not kept in snapshots, so a reloaded overlay never replays one.

avatarUrl.description: Twitch profile image (`https://static-cdn.jtvnw.net/` only); `null` when unknown.

durationMs.description: How long to show the card.

oneOf.description: Played once as the card shows; `null`: silent (the default).

stamps.description: Stamps on the current card, out of `slots`.

userName.description: Raw viewer text; overlays escape it when rendering.

CheckinToday.description: Today's check-ins (the business day in force now).

CheckinViewer.description:
One viewer with the stamp card derived from the total. `user_login` and `user_name` are raw Twitch text: escape
them when rendering.

last_check_in.description: Business day (`YYYY-MM-DD`) of the latest check-in; `null` when there is none.

stamps.description: Stamps on the current card, out of `card_slots`.

total.description: Viewers matching the search, across all pages.

ErrorBody.description:
Body of the errors admin handlers return: a stable `<area>.<reason>` code the admin UI translates.
The missing-token 401 has an empty body, and malformed JSON gets axum's plain-text rejection.

GeneralSettings.description: Settings → General. The desktop app reads the same `settings.json` flag on every ✕ of the admin window.

ask_before_close.description: Show the close hint on ✕; the hint's "Don't show again" turns it off.

ImportSkip.description: An entry left out. `key` is the file's own text (at most 64 characters): escape it when rendering.

ImportSummary.description: What an import adds, updates (replacing the imported baseline of known viewers) and skips.

date.description: A past business day to back-fill (`YYYY-MM-DD`); omitted or `null` registers today.

close.description:
With `enabled: false`: skip the module's outbox events instead of keeping them for later ("close"; the
default pauses). Enabling a closed module never delivers what was published while it was closed.

closed.description:
Disabled and skipping its outbox events ("close"); a disabled module that is not closed is paused and keeps
them for later.

password_set.description: Whether a password is stored; the password itself is never returned.

password.description: Absent keeps the stored password; empty removes it (OBS with authentication off).

ObsStatusEvent.description: An `obs.status` event exactly as `/ws/overlay` sends it; the snapshot keeps only the latest one.

ObsStatusPayload.description: The `payload` of an `obs.status` event, and the `status` of `GET /api/admin/obs`.

reason.description: Stable code such as `obs.auth_failed`; `null` when connected or right after startup.

PlaySound.description: A library sound to play: `url` is its file (`/sounds/{id}`), `volume` 0–100 (%).

RedemptionChangedEvent.description:
A `redemption.changed` event exactly as `/ws/overlay` sends it: a record was created or changed status. It
carries only the record ID, so viewer text stays off the overlay channel; the admin UI reloads the list.
Not kept in snapshots.

total.description: Records matching the filters, across all pages.

RedemptionRecord.description:
One redemption record. `user_name`, `reward_title` and `user_input` are raw viewer or Twitch text: escape them
when rendering.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC: when the record was created or last changed status.

user_input.description: Empty when the reward asks for nothing.

Reward.description: A channel points reward of the signed-in channel, for picking the check-in reward. `title` is raw Twitch text.

amount.description:
Months (`resubscribe`), subs (`gift`, 1 to 100), Bits (`cheer`) or raiders (`raid`), 1 to 100000;
ignored for the other kinds.

message.description: Up to 500 characters (`resubscribe`, `cheer`); ignored for the other kinds.

stamps.description: Stamps on the card, 1 to its slots; all of them shows the full-card effect.

sound.description: A sound's ID, `silent`, or `null` for the slot's default.

Snapshot.description: The first message on `/ws/overlay`: the recent retained events of each type.

obs.status.description: At most one: the latest status.

Sound.description: One imported sound. `label` is broadcaster text: render it as text. Its file is `GET /sounds/{id}`.

used_by.description: Slots that play it; deleting it puts them back to their defaults.

slots.description:
Chosen slots: `alert.<kind>`, `checkin`, `checkin.full` or `reward.<Twitch reward ID>` → a sound's ID or
`silent`. A slot left out plays its default: the built-in sound for alerts, nothing otherwise.

SoundPlayEvent.description:
A `sound.play` event exactly as `/ws/overlay` sends it: a reward sound for `/overlay/sound/`, which plays them
one at a time in order. Not kept in snapshots, so nothing replays after a reload or restart.

Source.description: Where an event came from. Simulated events never go into real business records.

TemplateChangedEvent.description: A `template.changed` event exactly as `/ws/overlay` sends it; not kept in snapshots.

error.description:
With `custom` selected: `template.missing`, `template.unreadable` or `template.invalid` while overlays
get the default template instead of the user's; otherwise `null`.
